data.name: Silver Elegant Butterflies Bracelet
data.short_description: The Silver Elegant Butterflies Bracelet is inspired by the moon showing up unexpectedly on a rainy night with a group of three twinkling stars.
data.description:
The Design:
This silver bracelet has a moon motif studded with zircon at the centre with two stars to its left and one star to its right.

925 Silver
Perfect for sensitive skin
Motif Size: Height - 0.85 cm, Motif Width - 1.35 cm
The length of the bracelet is 15 cm with a 4 cm adjustable portion
Comes with the GIVA Jewellery kit and authenticity certificate
Content: Bracelet
Net Qty- 1 unit
Styling Tip:
Style this bracelet with a pink patchwork cocktail dress.

data.name: Rose Gold My Love Bracelet
data.short_description: Don't hesitate any longer, it's the season of love -the perfect time to convey your feelings to that special someone.
data.description:
The Design:
This rose gold open-type bracelet features a heart motif that rotates and studded with zircons on one end and other end has a zircon studded heart in a circle, that has an open heart mechanism where you can custom inscribe the message. Celebrate your moments of passion with GIVA’s Red Romance Collection.

925 Silver with Rose Gold Plating
Perfect for sensitive skin
Bracelet Diameter: 5.5 cm + Adjustable
Comes with the GIVA Jewellery kit and authenticity certificate
Content: Bracelet
Net Qty- 1 unit
Styling Tip:
This bracelet would go well with a sheath dress.
